title: Oct 8 Surabaya student anti-Cipta Kerja action at Balai Kota / adjacent government sites

occurrence.value: Public protest reported on 8 Oct; students first at Grahadi and later at City Hall.

location.value: Surabaya; movement among Grahadi, Balai Kota and other sites is described; precise count at one fixed site unclear.

participant_count.value: Thousands reported around City Hall in one roundup, but separate regional story gives hundreds across three different Surabaya sites; exact site/time denominator disputed.

domestic_state_target.value: Opposition to domestic Cipta Kerja law is reported.

episode_ownership.value: Relationship to the broader Oct-Nov Cipta Kerja campaign and whether these are same-day moving stages vs separate gatherings remains unresolved.

title: Oct 20 labor/student demonstration at Monas and Patung Kuda, Jakarta

occurrence.value: Executed protest observed by reporter on 20 Oct.

location.value: Monas / Patung Kuda and Medan Merdeka Barat, Jakarta; workers were directed to west side of Patung Kuda and students approached from south.

participant_count.value: Suara Surabaya reports about 1,000 total by 15:00; ANTARA same-date Patung Kuda account attributes 2,750 total to police, but its stated 400 + 1,750 subgroups sum to 2,150. Same-event linkage and count denominator need reconciliation. Both are over 50 if they refer to same gathering.

domestic_state_target.value: Suara Surabaya reports demand that President cancel Cipta Kerja law; ANTARA frames the action as one-year evaluation of the President/Vice President, without spelling out specific demand.

episode_ownership.value: Campaign continuity before/after this date and whether this action is one episode in continuing mobilization requires adjacent-month follow-up.

title: Oct 8 anti-Cipta Kerja demonstrations in Makassar

location.value: DPRD South Sulawesi, flyover and multiple other points; source says 16 sites/action points.

participant_count.value: 73 and 250 are counts of people arrested, not participants; 250 detention count is pooled across 16 action points. No site-specific >=50 participant count established.
